name: Envoy
description: Spawn Claude Code agents that operate inside any local or remote project directory. Each agent runs as its own Claude CLI instance rooted in the target folder, with full access to that project's codebase and context. Supports parallel dispatch across multiple projects, SSH remote execution, model selection, and configurable timeouts.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `claude-envoy`.

Installs with `claude plugin install envoy@claude-community` from `michaelslain/claude-envoy`.

MCP server that dispatches Claude Code agents to any local or remote directory

Spawn Claude Code agents that operate inside any local or remote project directory. Each agent runs as its own Claude CLI instance rooted in the target folder, with full access to that project's codebase and context. Supports parallel dispatch across multiple projects, SSH remote execution, model selection, and configurable timeouts.
